RemoteAutomationWriteMapping.description: minimum < maximum; error tolerance is measured in the declared audible domain.

RemoteAutomationWriteStamp.description: controlFrame must equal outputFrame + latencyOffsetFrames within safe integer range; these are structural clocks, not an audible-onset promise.

RemoteAutomationWriteValueReply.description: applied disposition requires appliedSequence==sequence; superseded requires appliedSequence>sequence.

RemoteAutomationWriteLeaseUpdate.description: committed phase requires a nonnull authored revision.

RemoteAutomationWriteDraftReply.description: Nonempty captures require firstStamp and lastStamp; verified artifact bytes <=32MiB and SHA-256 hex digest.

RemoteAutomationWriteCapturedRamp.description: sequence is present exactly when restoring is false. Planned ramp endpoint does not claim every sample was applied.

RemoteAutomationWriteCapturedRelease.description: lastControlFrame/lastValue are both present or both absent; if present stamp.controlFrame is exactly lastControlFrame+1.

RemoteAutomationWriteDraftContent.description: Version1 bounded review data: one transport epoch/offset, strictly increasing captured source frames/sequences, restoration only last. Optional terminal absence means incomplete, never automatic reapply.

anyOf.description: One patch per case-insensitive UUID; duplicate target identities rejected by runtime validators.
